component.name: Cosmic Comics
component.summary: Comics and manga reader and collectionner

description.p: Cosmic Comics is a comics and manga reader and collection manager. Series and book information is fetched from online APIs or set manually.

ul.li: Read CBR, CBZ, CB7, CBT, ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, PDF, EPUB and folders of PNG, JPG, JPEG or BMP images
Browse your books and folders with custom covers, extracted automatically or set manually
Mark books as read, unread, reading or favorite, and rate them
Zoom, auto background color, double page mode, blank first page, manga mode, webtoon mode, fullscreen, rotations, bookmarks and slideshow
Library metadata from Marvel API, Google Books API, AniList and more
